_help: Partner programmes Nvoy can book. Shown in the Why Nvoy section and used by the travel-math tool to recognise a hotel's brand.

Each programme: id, name, group (the hotel company), brands (list of brand names or hotel names that identify it; matching is case-insensitive), perks (list), credit (typical credit wording), note (optional).
Perks vary by property and rate, so keep the wording to 'typically' and let Ankita confirm per booking.
Add or remove programmes freely. Set show to false to hide one from the list but keep it for brand recognition.
commonTerms apply to every programme; a programme's own terms list adds to them. hotels.json can add hotel-specific terms on top.
logo (optional): path to the programme's official logo in assets/img/programs/. Without it the tile shows the programme name in the site's typeface.

commonTerms: Perks apply to bookings made through Nvoy on eligible rates, usually the hotel's flexible or best available rate. Prepaid promotional rates, points redemptions and bookings on third-party sites don't qualify.
Room upgrades, early check-in and late check-out depend on availability on the day. The hotel decides at check-in; upgrades are usually to the next room category.
The hotel credit is per room, per stay (not per night), to spend at the hotel. It can't be exchanged for cash, doesn't cover taxes or gratuities, and anything unused is forfeited at check-out.
Breakfast is for the two registered adults in the room, at the hotel's main restaurant unless the hotel says otherwise.
One set of perks per room per stay. Blackout dates and minimum-stay rules may apply on some rates.
Hotels can change or withdraw programme benefits. I confirm the exact inclusions in writing before you pay.
